info.description:
Tracking what you have watched and where you left off, for films and TV series.

Every endpoint under /api/v1 requires an OIDC bearer token from a trusted issuer (Sign in with Apple or Google). The account is created on the first valid token, so there is no registration call. Endpoints act on the user the token identifies -- there is no way to name a different one.

Catalog metadata comes from TMDB. This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.
